name: Xiao Xiang Zhu
subject: Research internship inquiry: deep learning for remote sensing and Earth observation
body:
Dear Prof. Zhu,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in deep learning for remote sensing and Earth observation, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

Dear Prof. Tiefenbacher,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in deep learning for hydrology and water resources, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia

body:
Dear Prof. Ma,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in deep learning for natural hazards and disaster risk, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in deep learning for natural hazards and disaster risk, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in deep learning, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

Dear Prof. Zha,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in computer vision, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in machine learning for hydrology and water resources, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in machine learning, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

body:
Dear Prof. Zhou,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in machine learning, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in artificial intelligence, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

subject: Interested in data mining and machine learning
body:
Dear Prof. Zhang,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in data mining and machine learning, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

Dear Prof. Sigal,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in computer vision, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

Dear Prof. Dymond,

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in machine learning for hydrology and water resources, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay

I hope this message finds you well.

My name is Ruturva Vaghasia, an Environmental Science and Engineering undergraduate with a minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at IIT Bombay, where I hold a CPI of 9.28. I am writing to express my interest in working with you on research in artificial intelligence, an area I would like to go considerably deeper into.

I built a wildlife-detection model for image grids using handcrafted texture features and gradient-boosted trees. In another project on noisy human labels in image classification, I flagged likely mislabelled images from a CNN's own disagreement with each label (0.95 AUROC) and retrained on the cleaned set. I also analysed, in a group project, air-quality monitoring data from a station in Chennai, tracing pollution spikes to their likely causes and flagging faulty sensor readings.

I would be grateful for any opportunity to contribute to your group's work, and I would be glad to discuss how I could be of help.

My resume is attached for your reference. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Ruturva Vaghasia
B.Tech. Environmental Science and Engineering, Minor in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
Indian Institute of Technology Bombay
